author_packet_selection: TRAIN metadata only: SHA-ordered first three DIMACS sources and first three SATLIB sources, then both sides of the SHA-ordered first source pair in each of the six temporal regime/horizon families; 18 states. No quality or conditional-label filtering.
quality_normalization: Macro-average across the eight TRAIN families of exact feasible reward / total graph weight; this denominator is neither optimum nor a feasible best-method reference.
all_arms_share: Initializer, targets/regions, patch construction, include-first traversal, bounds and all caps. Program priority changes only the local feasible greedy proposal and pivot vertex.
cap_scope: Cooperative end-to-end nominal wall time and charged-operation cap; final incumbent validation is charged and any overshoot reported. An ordinary budget stop retains the feasible incumbent.
